newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks higher, but off highs in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks higher, but off highs in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were higher, but off from early highs, in late Monday trade as financials performed strongly to support the gains, brokers said.
With 60 minutes left, the index was up 40.08 points or 0.46 percent at 8,701.80. Turnover was a brisk T$77 billion.
Financials led the gains, rising 1.75 percent, with Hua Nan Bank up T$3.5 to T$126.5.
Foods and plastics also rose, but electronics, the recent gainers, fell on profit-taking.
"Players try to buy financials to keep the upswing as recent bellwether electronics (stocks) turn weak," said HSBC James Capel analyst Alex Chen.
"But whether financials can become another bellwether sector or not remains to be seen," Chen said.
